'''2000 California State Championship''' was a Star Wars CCG state championship held in California in spring 2000. [[Clayton Atkin]] won it; he posted his Dark deck as "the CCT Skrilling deck that I used to help me WIN the California State Championship", beating Mind What You Have Learned, Profit and an Obi-Wan's Hut deck in the final. He had earlier posted his Light Throne Room mains deck as the one "that I used at the CA state Championships".<ref name="dt-5580">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/5580 CA State Champion Light Deck], DeckTech (Clayton "TheDohMan" Atkin, 17 April 2000). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/5580/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/5580/ GitHub Pages].</ref><ref name="dt-7228">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/7228 Atkins Skrillings], DeckTech (Clayton "TheDohMan" Atkin, 28 May 2000). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/7228/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/7228/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Dates:''' 15 April 2000<ref name="tr-d545" />
* '''Site:''' California; Mountain View, California<ref name="tr-d545" />
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Clayton Atkin]]
* '''Players:''' 54<ref name="tr-d540" />

== Decklists ==
Players posted these lists on DeckTech as decks they played at the event; the posted list may differ slightly from the one played.

* [[2000 California State Championship Clayton Atkin Atkins Skrillings]] ([[Clayton Atkin]], [[Dark]]; 1st)
* [[2000 California State Championship Clayton Atkin CA State Champion Light Deck]] ([[Clayton Atkin]], [[Light]]; 1st) — "the Throne Rooms Mains deck that I used at the CA state Championships"
* [[2000 California State Championship Alfred Dong Not For A Sith]] ([[Alfred Dong]], [[Dark]]) — "Straight off the decklist from the CA States"
* [[2000 California State Championship Alfred Dong CA States Speed Profit Deck]] ([[Alfred Dong]], [[Light]]) — "made specially for states"; the post does not give his result
